Notice the emotion, body sensations, thoughts, and urges while allowing the experience to change over time.

## Text Version / Adapted Practice {#emotion-surfing}

Emotion Surfing uses a wave metaphor for the changing experience of emotion. Begin by naming the emotion as well as you can. Notice where it appears in the body, which thoughts or images accompany it, and which action urges arise. Let a comfortable breath or another present sensation serve as an anchor. Return to observing without demanding that the emotion disappear and without automatically acting on the urge.

The practice is about changing your relationship with an emotion, not guaranteeing a particular intensity or duration.

[Urge Surfing](/learn/wellness/urge-surfing.html) uses related noticing and wave imagery for an urge to act. The techniques are related but applied to different experiences.
